name: Twisting Gods Word
overview: Scripture sternly warns against twisting God's Word by calling evil good and good evil, as Isaiah 5:20 highlights the danger of reversing truth and moral clarity. The New Testament reinforces this by urging believers to guard against those who distort doctrine and cause division, as seen in Romans 16:17 and Galatians 1:6, where turning to another gospel is condemned. Revelation 22:18 further emphasizes the seriousness of altering God's prophetic words, promising divine judgment on those who add to Scripture. Together, these verses call Christians to remain steadfast in the pure gospel and truthful teaching, avoiding any corruption of God's revealed truth.
